提交信息:
```
fix(feature_h5): disable iOS edge-swipe pop gesture on H5 WebView page

WKWebView's internal touch/scroll gesture recognizers conflict with
Flutter's CupertinoPageTransitionsBuilder back-swipe gesture, causing
a tap inside the WebView to accidentally pop the page. Pin
PopScope.canPop to false to disable that system gesture, and use
Navigator.pop() instead of maybePop() for explicit back navigation
so it isn't blocked by the same guard.
```
